subject: Alpha Apps: request for latest penetration test evidence and secure transfer options
messages:
From: Danielle Price <dprice@alphaapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alpha Apps Security <security@alphaapps.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Request: latest penetration test report for hosted API (for compliance)

Hi Marissa,

We are conducting a compliance review for Alpha Apps' integration with Redwood's Hosted API and need the most recent penetration test report and a brief scope explanation. Specifically:
- Full report (redacted as needed) or a summary PDF
- Scope: which environments were tested (prod/staging), any third-party infra in scope, and date of test
- Current remediation status for open findings (if possible)

Can you advise on secure transfer options? We prefer an SFTP or secure portal delivery, and we already have an NDA and DP agreement in place. Our deadline is Dec 8 for internal auditors.

Thanks,
Danielle
Danielle Price
Security Analyst, Alpha Apps
security@alphaapps.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Price <dprice@alphaapps.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report for hosted API (for compliance)

Hi Danielle —

Thanks for the note. We can share the penetration test report for the Hosted API. A few quick clarifying questions so we package the right artifacts:
1) Do you need the full, unredacted report, or will a redacted copy + executive summary suffice for your auditors?
2) Which environment(s) should be explicitly documented in the scope (prod only, prod + staging, or additional customer-facing testbeds)?
3) Do you want remediation status (current ticket IDs and ETA) included in the handoff?

Delivery options we support:
- Presigned S3 link (encrypted at rest, link expiry configurable)
- Secure customer portal (SAML-protected document view)
- SFTP transfer (restricted credentials + IP allowlist)

I have looped in Vivek (Security) and Neha (Compliance) to coordinate redactions and transfer. If you confirm preferences, we can prepare and send within 1 business day.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Danielle Price <dprice@alphaapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alpha Apps Security <security@alphaapps.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report for hosted API (for compliance)

Thanks, Marissa.

Preferred: secure portal or SFTP (portal preferred). We need documented scope to specifically note: Hosted API (production) and any cloud infra used by Redwood that directly affects the API (e.g., edge caching, load balancers).
Please include remediation status for open findings; auditors want ETA and whether fixes are deployed to prod.

Can you target sending by EOD today or first thing tomorrow?

- Danielle
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:32:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Alpha Apps — PT evidence request (hosted API)

Vivek / Neha —

Alpha Apps (Danielle) has requested the latest PT report for the Hosted API and prefers portal delivery. They specifically want confirmation of scope (prod hosted API + any third-party infra in scope) and remediation status for open findings. Deadline: Dec 8, but they'd like the package sooner if possible (EOD today / tomorrow morning).

Can we:
- Approve sharing the full report to this external contact under existing NDA?
- Apply our standard redaction checklist and produce a portal-safe PDF if necessary?
- Provide short remediation notes (ticket IDs, ETA, deployed date) for open items?

Attachments: pt_scoped_assets.csv (list of hosts/services), redaction-checklist.pdf

Thx — I can coordinate the upload/delivery once you confirm the mechanism.

Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T12:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Alpha Apps — PT evidence request (hosted API)

Marissa —

Approved to share the report with Alpha Apps under the existing NDA. Use the standard redaction checklist (attached) — redact internal IP routing tables and specific vendor access credentials. We can provide the following scope statement in the package:
- Test date: 2026-11-01
- Environments: Hosted API (production), staging used for pre-release regression (limited scope)
- Third-party: cloud provider managed infra (compute/network) and CDN edge caching identified in scoped assets

Remediation status (summary):
- Open findings: 2 medium (IDs: SUP-2198, SUP-2241).
- Fixes: patch deployed to edge routing service (rolled out 2026-11-25).
- ETA for remaining work: 2027-01-15 (full verification retest scheduled 2026-12-10).

Delivery: I will generate a presigned S3 link that expires in 7 days and password-protect the PDF. If Alpha prefers portal access, we can create a portal session but that takes ~2 business days for SAML provisioning. Given their timeline, presigned link + password is fastest.

Link (sent separately to customer): https://s3.redwood.example/presigned/alphaapps_pt_abc123?expires=1701577200

Attaching redaction-checklist.pdf and pt_scoped_assets.csv for the package.

-Vivek

Marissa
From: Danielle Price <dprice@alphaapps.com>

Marissa / Vivek —

Received the link and downloaded the package successfully. Password worked and files open. Quick follow-ups:
1) Can you include the change log for SUP-2198 (ticket link is fine) so our auditors can see the patch details?
